description: This file defines the RemotePlugin class within the WPEFramework Plugin Rust namespace. It declares the class's interface, including constructors, destructors, lifecycle methods, and communication functions for a plugin that interacts with Rust code via a socket server. It also includes conditional compilation for different Thunder versions and JSON-RPC contexts.

classes.name: RemotePlugin
classes.description: A plugin class that manages remote communication with Rust code, including lifecycle management, message invocation, and socket communication.
